areas.name: Windows Service Route and Snapshot Rules
areas.location_cue: The global PC login, account menu, version display, and permanent progress panels.
areas.note: The guide is a dated global-server snapshot, not a promise that a changing service can remain finished forever.

save_backup.title: Protect the current account state
save_backup.why: Service accounts have no local save branch, so preserve dated menu evidence.
save_backup.detail: Keep dated screenshots and a local checklist before the service changes.

levels.1: Use the native PC service.
levels.2: Install the global Windows client and link the intended account.
levels.3: Use the official global PC client, record client and server version 4.5, link the account before spending resources, and capture the player ID plus region. Mobile is a continuity option, not a separate content route.

levels.1: A live service needs a dated finish line.
levels.2: Treat July 29, 2026 and global version 4.5 as this guide's boundary.
levels.3: Complete all permanent content available in global version 4.5, then archive the menus on July 29, 2026. Later chapters, characters, Personas, events, and system expansions belong to a new dated revision rather than making this snapshot retroactively incomplete.

levels.1: Secure the service identity before investing time.
levels.2: Link the account and preserve its recovery details outside the game.
levels.3: Bind the account through the official user menu, verify login on the same server, store the player ID and recovery method securely, and never rely on a guest profile for completion work.

levels.1: Some progress is rationed by resets.
levels.2: Record the server reset time and clear permanent weekly counters before they roll.
levels.3: Maintain a dated checklist for stamina, weekly challenge attempts, pass tasks, shop limits, and rotating trials. Claim completed rows before reset; an unclaimed reward may not survive the next service window.

levels.1: Do not spend scarce resources without a registry plan.
levels.2: Reserve premium currency, universal shards, rare inks, and high-grade upgrade materials.
levels.3: Before upgrading, compare the permanent registry and current availability. Spend account-limited materials only on a documented target, keep one untouched resource snapshot, and avoid treating duplicate-gated Awareness levels as routine free completion.

levels.1: Other regions preview content that this account cannot obtain.
levels.2: Exclude every database row marked CN from the global completion denominator.
levels.3: Audit only rows visible or obtainable on the global server. Keep CN-only characters and Personas in the internal research appendix, and add them to the public checklist only after an official global release.

levels.1: Limited contracts cannot define ordinary 100%.
levels.2: Track owned characters fully; record unavailable limited rows separately.
levels.3: For normal completion, finish permanent systems and fully document every character actually owned. Do not require six duplicate Awareness upgrades or every limited contract result; note missed and future reruns as service availability, not player failure.

levels.1: A service snapshot needs visible evidence.
levels.2: Capture every permanent registry, progress panel, and claimed completion row.
levels.3: At the snapshot boundary, record story progress without plot scenes, Palace exploration percentages, Mementos paths, Persona registry, owned-character list, Synergies, social stats, challenge records, card sets, weapon records, and the rotating-content ledger.

levels.1: Follow the permanent objective marker at your own pace.
levels.2: Complete every globally available main-story objective through version 4.5.
levels.3: Advance the permanent main route until the version 4.5 client presents no further main-story objective. Clear every required Palace operation and preserve a spoiler-free screenshot of the chapter panel; this guide deliberately withholds scene names and outcomes.

levels.1: Return to city and character menus after each main unlock.
levels.2: Clear every side story that remains permanently selectable on the global account.
levels.3: Open the Side Story, Synergy, and event-archive menus after every account-level increase. Finish all entries without an expiry badge, claim their rewards, and verify each permanent row shows complete.

levels.1: Some side narratives belong to expired service windows.
levels.2: Review the archive and record which historical event stories remain replayable.
levels.3: Open the event archive and test every listed past story. Complete replayable rows, mark inaccessible rows as unavailable on this account, and never represent an expired first-run reward as normally obtainable.
